# Keep header enum sentinels synchronized with indexed storage

The compose field cleanup removes the news-host header enum entry along with its header array row. Accepted MsgHeaderID uses a using alias and retains MSG_MAX_HEADERS as the final sentinel for m_headers storage. Preserve that paired ordering when editing this enum family. The alias change is an accepted local modern syntax example, not evidence that all legacy typedefs must be rewritten. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Compose header enum and alias syntax.
